decisions.reason: The organic poultry mini salami snack fits the firm's organic and snacking direction, but as a niche single item now in its third year it faces rising retail delisting risk after the flagship organic salami platter was withdrawn.
The premium sharing salami line uses the firm's core curing strengths and serves the growing convenience snacking segment, so it remains a solid part of the assortment.
Organic Fleischwurst is a newly launched staple that extends the organic team with a classic, broadly demanded product, giving it a low early withdrawal risk.
The thinly sliced organic chicken breast line in two variants targets health-conscious shoppers and expands into new formats, consistent with the firm's strategy.
The organic herb-coated salami is a recent launch close to the firm's core salami expertise and has had little time to prove itself, so it stays despite some overlap within the organic salami range.
